form.label: AD Objects - ML - Risk Overview
form.description: Model-driven entity risk from the AD_Obj_Risk KV Store collection. Populated by the AD_Obj_ML_*_Apply / _Alert scheduled searches. Requires MLTK 5.4+ for the DensityFunction and KMeans models.

search.query: | inputlookup AD_Obj_Risk | eval last_scored=tonumber(last_scored), first_seen=tonumber(first_seen), risk_score=tonumber(risk_score) | where isnotnull(last_scored) AND last_scored>=relative_time(now(),"$tok_lookback$") | search risk_type="$tok_risk_type$" | eval scored_day=strftime(last_scored,"%Y-%m-%d") | eval _time=last_scored

panel.title: Risk Rows Over Time by Risk Type

search.query: search entity_type="$tok_entity_type$" | timechart span=1d count by risk_type

panel.title: Risk Rows and Mean Score by Risk Type

search.query: search entity_type="$tok_entity_type$" | stats count AS risk_rows, dc(entity) AS entities, avg(risk_score) AS avg_risk_score, max(risk_score) AS max_risk_score, dc(scored_day) AS scored_days, values(mitre_technique_id) AS mitre_technique_id, values(model) AS model by risk_type | eval avg_risk_score=round(avg_risk_score,4), max_risk_score=round(max_risk_score,4) | eval rows_per_day=round(risk_rows/max(scored_days,1),2) | table risk_type,model,mitre_technique_id,risk_rows,entities,rows_per_day,avg_risk_score,max_risk_score | sort - risk_rows

panel.title: Top Risky Entities (click a row to load its evidence below)

search.query: search entity_type="$tok_entity_type$" | stats max(risk_score) AS peak_risk_score, avg(risk_score) AS avg_risk_score, count AS risk_rows, dc(risk_type) AS distinct_risk_types, values(risk_type) AS risk_types, values(mitre_technique_id) AS mitre_technique_id, min(first_seen) AS first_seen, max(last_scored) AS last_scored by entity,entity_type,domain | eval peak_risk_score=round(peak_risk_score,4), avg_risk_score=round(avg_risk_score,4) | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last_scored=strftime(last_scored,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval composite=round(peak_risk_score*distinct_risk_types,4) | table entity,entity_type,domain,composite,peak_risk_score,avg_risk_score,risk_rows,distinct_risk_types,risk_types,mitre_technique_id,first_seen,last_scored | sort - composite, - peak_risk_score | head 50

search entity_type="$tok_entity_type$" entity="$tok_drill_entity$" | eval scored=strftime(last_scored,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table scored,entity,entity_type,domain,risk_type,risk_score,mitre_technique_id,model,model_version,evidence | sort - scored, - risk_score

html.div: Rows are written by the AD_Obj_ML_ChangeVelocity_Apply, AD_Obj_ML_PeerGroup_Apply and AD_Obj_ML_PrivPath_Alert searches. Select a row in "Top Risky Entities" to filter this panel; leave it unselected to see every entity in the window.

panel.title: Triage Narrative $tok_drill_entity$ (descriptive only - the KV values are shown beside it)

search.query: search entity_type="$tok_entity_type$" entity="$tok_drill_entity$" | stats max(risk_score) AS risk_score, values(risk_type) AS risk_type, values(model) AS model, values(model_version) AS model_version, values(mitre_technique_id) AS mitre_technique_id, values(evidence) AS evidence, min(first_seen) AS first_seen, max(last_scored) AS last_scored, count AS risk_rows by entity,entity_type,domain | eval risk_type=mvjoin(risk_type,","), model=mvjoin(model,","), model_version=mvjoin(model_version,","), mitre_technique_id=mvjoin(mitre_technique_id,","), evidence=mvjoin(evidence," | ") | sort - risk_score | head 10 | adtriage entity_field=entity mode="$tok_ai_mode$" | eval Narration=case(ai_status=="llm","AI narrative (model: ".ai_model.")",ai_status=="template","Rule-based template narrative (AI disabled)",true(),"Rule-based template narrative (fallback: ".ai_status.")") | eval scored=strftime(last_scored,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table entity,entity_type,domain,risk_score,risk_type,mitre_technique_id,scored,Narration,ai_triage,model,model_version,evidence | rename ai_triage AS "Triage narrative"

html.div: The narrative is descriptive, never prescriptive - it restates what the model scored and what the directory data shows, and recommends nothing. The underlying risk_score, model, evidence and MITRE mapping stay on the row beside it so you always see the source values. The Narration column states whether a model produced the text or whether it is the deterministic template. Set Triage Narrative to "Template only" to guarantee no model is contacted; see README.txt section "5.0.0 GenAI / LLM (Phase 2)".

panel.title: Model Drift - Current 7 Days vs Prior 7 Days (mirrors AD_Obj_ML_Drift_Check)

search.query: | inputlookup AD_Obj_Risk | eval last_scored=tonumber(last_scored), risk_score=tonumber(risk_score) | where isnotnull(last_scored) AND last_scored>=relative_time(now(),"-14d@d") | eval week_bucket=if(last_scored>=relative_time(now(),"-7d@d"),"current","prior") | eval scored_day=strftime(last_scored,"%Y-%m-%d") | stats count AS risk_rows, dc(entity) AS entities, dc(scored_day) AS scored_days, avg(risk_score) AS avg_risk_score, values(model) AS model, values(model_version) AS model_version by risk_type,week_bucket | eval outlier_rate=round(risk_rows/max(scored_days,1),4) | stats max(eval(if(week_bucket=="current",outlier_rate,null()))) AS current_rate, max(eval(if(week_bucket=="prior",outlier_rate,null()))) AS prior_rate, max(eval(if(week_bucket=="current",entities,null()))) AS current_entities, max(eval(if(week_bucket=="prior",entities,null()))) AS prior_entities, max(eval(if(week_bucket=="current",avg_risk_score,null()))) AS current_avg_score, max(eval(if(week_bucket=="prior",avg_risk_score,null()))) AS prior_avg_score, values(model) AS model, values(model_version) AS model_version by risk_type | fillnull value=0 current_rate,prior_rate,current_entities,prior_entities,current_avg_score,prior_avg_score | eval rate_ratio=case(prior_rate==0 AND current_rate==0,1,prior_rate==0,99,true(),round(current_rate/prior_rate,4)) | eval drift=if(rate_ratio>3 OR rate_ratio<0.3333,"true","false") | eval drift_direction=case(rate_ratio>3,"increase",rate_ratio<0.3333,"decrease",true(),"stable") | eval current_avg_score=round(current_avg_score,4), prior_avg_score=round(prior_avg_score,4) | eval score_delta=round(current_avg_score-prior_avg_score,4) | eval model=mvjoin(model,";"), model_version=mvjoin(model_version,";") | table risk_type,model,model_version,drift,drift_direction,rate_ratio,current_rate,prior_rate,current_entities,prior_entities,current_avg_score,prior_avg_score,score_delta | sort - rate_ratio

| rest /servicesNS/-/-/saved/searches splunk_server=local count=0 | rename "eai:acl.app" AS app_context, "eai:acl.owner" AS owner | search app_context="ms_windows_ad_objects" title="AD_Obj_ML_*" | fields title,owner,cron_schedule,disabled,is_scheduled,next_scheduled_time | eval schedule_state=case(disabled=="1","Disabled (ship default)",is_scheduled=="1","Enabled - Scheduled",true(),"Enabled - Not Scheduled") | eval model=case(match(title,"ChangeVelocity"),"ad_obj_change_velocity_df (DensityFunction)",match(title,"PeerGroup"),"ad_obj_peer_kmeans (KMeans k=8)",match(title,"PrivPath"),"ad_obj_privpath_spl (SPL graph, no MLTK)",true(),"model ops") | join type=left title [ search index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler app=ms_windows_ad_objects savedsearch_name="AD_Obj_ML_*" earliest=-14d latest=now | stats latest(status) AS last_run_status, latest(_time) AS last_run_epoch, latest(result_count) AS last_result_count, avg(run_time) AS avg_run_time_sec, count AS runs_14d by savedsearch_name | rename savedsearch_name AS title ] | eval last_run=if(isnull(last_run_epoch),"never",strftime(last_run_epoch,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) | eval last_run_status=if(isnull(last_run_status),"n/a",last_run_status) | eval avg_run_time_sec=if(isnull(avg_run_time_sec),0,round(avg_run_time_sec,1)) | eval runs_14d=if(isnull(runs_14d),0,runs_14d) | table title,model,schedule_state,cron_schedule,next_scheduled_time,last_run,last_run_status,last_result_count,avg_run_time_sec,runs_14d | sort title

panel.title: Model Artifacts - Fitted MLTK Models Present in This App

search.query: | rest /servicesNS/-/-/data/lookup-table-files splunk_server=local count=0 | rename "eai:acl.app" AS app_context, "eai:acl.sharing" AS sharing, "eai:acl.owner" AS owner | search app_context="ms_windows_ad_objects" title="__mlspl_ad_obj_*" | eval model=replace(title,"^__mlspl_(.*)\.mlmodel$","\1") | eval expected=case(model=="ad_obj_change_velocity_df","AD_Obj_ML_ChangeVelocity_Fit",model=="ad_obj_peer_kmeans","AD_Obj_ML_PeerGroup_Fit",true(),"unmapped") | table model,expected,title,sharing,owner,updated | sort model

html.div: An empty table means no model has been fitted yet. Enable and run AD_Obj_ML_ChangeVelocity_Fit and AD_Obj_ML_PeerGroup_Fit once at least 30 days of "AD Objects - ML Feature - ..." rows exist in the summary index.

panel.title: Model Evaluation - Precision / Recall / F1 by Risk Type (mirrors AD_Obj_ML_Eval_Score)

search.query: | inputlookup ms_ad_obj_ml_evalset | eval entity_norm=lower(mvindex(split(entity,"\\"),-1)) | eval label=case(lower(expected_detection)=="true","positive",lower(expected_detection)=="false","negative",true(),"unlabeled") | where label!="unlabeled" | fields scenario_id,risk_type,entity_norm,label,severity | append [| inputlookup AD_Obj_Risk | eval last_scored=tonumber(last_scored), risk_score=tonumber(risk_score) | where isnotnull(last_scored) AND last_scored>=relative_time(now(),"$tok_lookback$") | eval entity_norm=lower(mvindex(split(entity,"\\"),-1)) | stats max(risk_score) AS detected_score, count AS detected_rows by risk_type,entity_norm] | stats values(label) AS label, max(detected_score) AS detected_score, sum(detected_rows) AS detected_rows by risk_type,entity_norm | eval detected=if(isnull(detected_score),0,1), labeled=if(isnull(label),0,1) | eval outcome=case(label=="positive" AND detected==1,"TP",label=="positive" AND detected==0,"FN",label=="negative" AND detected==1,"FP",label=="negative" AND detected==0,"TN",labeled==0 AND detected==1,"FP_UNLABELED",true(),"NA") | stats count(eval(outcome=="TP")) AS true_positives, count(eval(outcome=="FP")) AS false_positives, count(eval(outcome=="FN")) AS false_negatives, count(eval(outcome=="TN")) AS true_negatives, count(eval(outcome=="FP_UNLABELED")) AS false_positives_unlabeled, count(eval(labeled==1)) AS labeled_scenarios by risk_type | eval precision=if((true_positives+false_positives)==0,null(),round(true_positives/(true_positives+false_positives),4)) | eval recall=if((true_positives+false_negatives)==0,null(),round(true_positives/(true_positives+false_negatives),4)) | eval f1=if(isnull(precision) OR isnull(recall) OR (precision+recall)==0,null(),round(2*precision*recall/(precision+recall),4)) | eval precision_incl_unlabeled=if((true_positives+false_positives+false_positives_unlabeled)==0,null(),round(true_positives/(true_positives+false_positives+false_positives_unlabeled),4)) | eval false_positive_rate=if((false_positives+true_negatives)==0,null(),round(false_positives/(false_positives+true_negatives),4)) | eval model=case(risk_type=="change_velocity","ad_obj_change_velocity_df",risk_type=="peer_logon_deviation","ad_obj_peer_kmeans",risk_type=="priv_path_change","ad_obj_privpath_spl",true(),"unmapped") | table risk_type,model,labeled_scenarios,true_positives,false_positives,false_negatives,true_negatives,false_positives_unlabeled,precision,recall,f1,precision_incl_unlabeled,false_positive_rate | sort risk_type

html.div: Read these numbers only after a labeled corpus replay. precision / recall / f1 are computed over the entities named in lookups/ms_ad_obj_ml_evalset.csv only. false_positives_unlabeled counts risk rows for entities the eval set says nothing about - on a clean corpus replay those are real false positives and precision_incl_unlabeled is the honest figure; on live production data they are simply unlabeled and that column should be ignored. An empty table means the eval-set lookup is present but no model has written to AD_Obj_Risk in the selected lookback. There is no production-validated false-positive rate for these models - this harness is how you measure your own. See README.txt section "5.0.0 Validation & Release (Phase 3)".

panel.title: Model Evaluation - False Positives and False Negatives (labeled scenarios)

search.query: | inputlookup ms_ad_obj_ml_evalset | eval entity_norm=lower(mvindex(split(entity,"\\"),-1)) | eval label=case(lower(expected_detection)=="true","positive",lower(expected_detection)=="false","negative",true(),"unlabeled") | where label!="unlabeled" | fields scenario_id,scenario_name,entity,entity_norm,entity_type,domain,risk_type,label,mitre_technique_id,severity,notes | append [| inputlookup AD_Obj_Risk | eval last_scored=tonumber(last_scored), risk_score=tonumber(risk_score) | where isnotnull(last_scored) AND last_scored>=relative_time(now(),"$tok_lookback$") | eval entity_norm=lower(mvindex(split(entity,"\\"),-1)) | stats max(risk_score) AS detected_score, count AS detected_rows, values(model) AS detected_model, max(last_scored) AS detected_last by risk_type,entity_norm] | stats values(scenario_id) AS scenario_id, values(scenario_name) AS scenario_name, values(entity) AS labeled_entity, values(entity_type) AS entity_type, values(domain) AS domain, values(label) AS label, values(mitre_technique_id) AS mitre_technique_id, values(severity) AS severity, values(notes) AS notes, max(detected_score) AS detected_score, sum(detected_rows) AS detected_rows, values(detected_model) AS detected_model, max(detected_last) AS detected_last by risk_type,entity_norm | eval detected=if(isnull(detected_score),0,1), labeled=if(isnull(label),0,1) | eval outcome=case(label=="positive" AND detected==1,"TP",label=="positive" AND detected==0,"FN",label=="negative" AND detected==1,"FP",label=="negative" AND detected==0,"TN",labeled==0 AND detected==1,"FP_UNLABELED",true(),"NA") | search outcome IN ("FP","FN","FP_UNLABELED") | eval scenario_id=if(isnull(scenario_id),"(unlabeled entity)",scenario_id) | eval scenario_name=if(isnull(scenario_name),"not present in ms_ad_obj_ml_evalset",scenario_name) | eval detected_last=if(isnull(detected_last),"never",strftime(detected_last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) | eval detected_score=if(isnull(detected_score),"-",detected_score) | fillnull value=0 detected_rows | table outcome,risk_type,scenario_id,scenario_name,entity_norm,labeled_entity,entity_type,domain,severity,mitre_technique_id,detected_model,detected_score,detected_rows,detected_last,notes | sort outcome,risk_type,scenario_id

html.div: FN = a labeled positive scenario the model did not score (missed detection). FP = a labeled benign scenario the model did score. FP_UNLABELED = a risk row for an entity that is not in the eval set at all. The notes column states what the scenario was designed to test, so a row here is a starting point for tuning (`ms_ad_obj_risk_threshold` for change velocity, the peer_z floor and k for peer group, the depth/change weights for privilege path) rather than a defect on its own.
